svg.title: Interactive GPU benchmark comparison
svg.desc: Six benchmark metrics across six Sustainability Lab machines. Bars are scaled independently within each metric. Every row includes its machine name and measured value; hover, focus, or select a row for details.
svg.text: Bars are scaled separately within each metric. Select a machine to trace it across all rows.
